notes.title: New Version 1.4.5.0 Update Overview
notes.content:
Hello everyone, I’m Zhang Liang002! Thank you for your patience and for your love and support for the game! Today, we have a brand new version update. Here are the details of this update! Enjoy!

1.Continue Exploration with More Details: When hovering over “Continue Exploration,” detailed information from the last exploration will be displayed.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45078054/23e865ac5c3ee758e52bfa09d721da66350b8ba0.png[/img]

2.New Multi-Save System (Unlocks after completing the Epsilon Galaxy, supports up to 1 auto-save + 5 manual saves)!
To maintain the challenge and fun of the game, the multi-save feature unlocks after completing the Epsilon Galaxy (unlocks when you can challenge the final level). The default auto-save function remains unchanged!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45078054/2ea7dc1242a88318c3b5f4f13c483d0c1de63cad.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45078054/899e3793f7376ad8c2f5af418f86d93b619fbbff.png[/img]

4.Alchemist Enhancement: Can Equip Apocalypse Cannon from the Start

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45078054/6fc44492ad524c8aefd088e935a14ad9cb3ccb2b.png[/img]

5.Window Settings: Added Hotkey Tips. When using multiple monitors, you can use the hotkey (F11) to drag the game window to another monitor and press F11 again to switch displays!

notes.title: New version update 1.2.0.0
notes.content:
Hello everyone, I am game author Zhang Liang002! On the eve of the game's release, version 1.2.0.0 of the game has been developed! Developing a game by one person is a huge project. Here are the latest updates for version 1.2.0.0:
﻿
1. New feature "Rotating Core": The "Rotating Core" function has been added in the "Laboratory" - "Custom Core" section, which allows for the rotation of the core and more flexible use of cores with fewer than 4 interfaces!
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45078054/af782771ecb952c7a665bf24c162ef2fa09dc6f3.png[/img]
﻿
2.If "Custom Core" is used, a custom icon prompt will be added to the corresponding core in the core list to facilitate finding the modified core.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45078054/35cb41f5413ffb6476b76747c35f49dfae87530e.png[/img]

3. The basic damage and damage growth of the unit's "three point spectral cannon" have been significantly improved
4. The price of the unit's "treatment turret" has been lowered
5. The cooling of the unit's "radiation engine" attack has been improved
﻿
6. Price reduction for chip "PlayerUnknown's Battlegrounds"
7. Chip "supply upgrade" adjusted to limit 5
8. Chip "alien technology" technology+3 upgraded to+10
9. Chip "high-tech barrier" -20% damage adjusted to -25% damage
10. Chip 'comprehensive upgrade' cancels operation -2
11. Chip "free"+25% movement speed
12. Price reduction for chip "time acceleration"
13. Chip "firepower coverage" long-range damage, technology upgraded from+8 to+10

14. Core "Unknown Hero" Unknown Hero Adjustment: Attack Speed+50% reduced to+25%, Critical Strike Rate reduced from+25% to+20%
﻿
15. Fixed a serious bug where "time reversal" would travel to other galaxies after reading an archive
﻿
Friendly reminder: In the "Laboratory" - "Custom Functions" section, enable the "Seal" and "Recycle" functions to easily build a more perfect spaceship!
﻿[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45078054/07f62606f1f5ecc4e02f27ada441bdec147f4b6e.png[/img]

In addition, the game has a brand new ranking system. After clearing the galaxy, select "Endless Mode" and complete one battle to unlock the "Global Ranking". If you are interested, you can also challenge it!
﻿
If you like games, welcome to join Discord: https://discord.gg/PrAab7gd8S I will answer everyone's questions in the Steam community and Discord!
